Research method

The official workflow, explained for better decisions.

PikoBuy publicly describes a flow that can begin with product searches, links, images or sourcing requests; items then go through warehouse inspection and repacking before international shipping. This guide turns that broad flow into checks a shopper can make before saving a product.

01 / DISCOVER

Begin with the real source clue

Use a product name, category or raw link. Avoid deciding from a short title alone.

02 / CHECK

Read QC and size context

Compare useful photos, measurements, source relevance and likely package weight.

03 / PLAN

Treat shipping as part of value

A low product price can change once packaging, route and weight are considered.

One useful next step

Browse intentionally

Choose a category before you open more tabs.

Product types need different evidence. Shoes need shape and sole views; apparel needs size context; bags and accessories need dimensions and detail photos. Continue from any category to FindSpreadsheet.

Quality control

How to read QC photos without over-trusting them.

QC photographs can help you examine visible shape, colour, material details, measurements and included parts. They cannot verify a seller, promise quality or replace official order support.

01

Match the item

Check that the product, colour and size label make sense for the source you saved.

02

Look for the relevant angles

A shoe, jacket and watch need different visual checks; do not treat one generic photo as enough evidence.

03

Keep the boundary

Questions about an active item, exchange, payment or refund belong with the official account service.

Shipping planning

Weight is part of the buying decision.

PikoBuy says items are inspected and repacked at its China warehouse, then sent with a shipping option selected by the user. Exact quotes, routes, taxes and delivery times can change. Treat early estimates as planning context—not a promise.

CHECKLIST

Before shipping

1. Compare similar items by likely package weight. 2. Check size and packaging context. 3. Review current official shipping choices in your own account. 4. Check destination import rules yourself.

FAQ

Short answers, with no made-up promises.

Is PikoVIP an official PikoBuy site?

No. It is an independent research guide. It does not take payments, process orders, arrange shipping or access accounts.

Why does the search go to FindSpreadsheet?

FindSpreadsheet is the product-discovery database. PikoVIP provides the context before browsing, then hands you to the database.

Can a QC photo guarantee quality?

No. Photos can show visible details but cannot guarantee quality, authenticity, seller behaviour, stock, shipping or customs outcomes.

Which countries can use PikoBuy?

The public site says it ships worldwide, but availability can depend on current routes and destination rules. Confirm service and costs in the official flow.
